title: A custom beat with a release-ready file set
lead: A dark trap beat built to your tempo, key and mood, checked automatically for timing, loudness and peaks.

hero.caption: Grid check: hits per instrument and the largest offset from the grid.
hero.alt: Grid check: hits per instrument and the largest offset from the grid.

problem: An artist needs a beat in their own mood rather than one from a catalogue, with nothing to complain about in the sound: steady rhythm, right loudness, cover and details in place.
built: A beat at 130 BPM, D# minor, 1:30; files: WAV, MP3, MIDI notes.
Grid checked part by part: kick 105 hits, max offset 1.8 ms against a 10 ms tolerance; clap 35 hits, 0 ms; hi-hat 192 hits, 0.3 ms.
Loudness -10.01 LUFS, true peak -2.0 dBTP; after lossy compression (Opus, 160 kbps) the peak is -0.49 dBFS, no clipping.
A distributor folder: 3000x3000 cover, track details (tempo, key, length).

shots.caption: The file set for a distributor.
shots.alt: The file set for a distributor.

steps: You describe tempo, key and mood.
A beat is built to the brief.
The grid, loudness and peaks are checked automatically.
You get the files and the check report.
stack: A browser-based app on my own computer (the software itself is not for sale)
offer: 1 version of the beat to your brief and 1 revision of tempo and mood.
WAV, MP3 and MIDI files and the check report.
not_included: Vocal recording and lyrics; genres other than dark trap; a guarantee that a platform will not block the track with an automatic copyright check.
price_en: On request, after a short brief
